fpi_sector_3m.text: FPI net equity flow over the last 3 months (6 NSDL fortnights) is at least 1.5% of the sector's FPI equity holdings, in either direction.
fpi_sector_3m.mechanism: Foreign portfolio investors' disclosed net equity buying or selling in the sector

mf_sector_breadth.text: Fund-house net breadth (adds+new minus trims+exits, as % of all moves, active schemes, latest month vs previous) is at least +40% or at most -40%, with 10 or more moves.
mf_sector_breadth.mechanism: Breadth of domestic fund-house position changes in the sector's stocks

mf_stock_breadth.text: Three or more fund houses moved the same way in one stock in the latest month (net count of fund houses adding/new minus trimming/exiting).
mf_stock_breadth.mechanism: Several fund houses changed positions in the same company in the same month

rating_balance_90d.text: Over the 90 days to the agency's latest action, (upgrades - downgrades) / (upgrades + downgrades) is at least +0.6 or at most -0.6, with 6 or more of them. Defaults are listed but kept out of the balance (many are small-borrower 'D' moves). Each agency separately; 'Issuer Not Cooperating' moves excluded.
rating_balance_90d.mechanism: Balance of credit-rating upgrades and downgrades among the sector's rated borrowers

bank_credit_yoy.text: Outstanding bank credit to the sector (RBI SIBC, mapped codes, outstanding-weighted) grew 25% or more year on year, or did not grow (0% or less).
bank_credit_yoy.mechanism: Pace of bank lending to the sector (outstanding credit, not new sanctions)

inst_breadth_qoq.text: Share of the sector's companies whose institutional holding rose quarter on quarter is 65% or more, or 35% or less (10 or more companies).
inst_breadth_qoq.mechanism: Breadth of institutional holding increases across the sector's listed companies

inst_share_company.text: Institutional holding of a Nifty 500 company changed by 3 percentage points or more quarter on quarter (NSE shareholding pattern).
inst_share_company.mechanism: Change in the institutional share of the company's equity
